info.title: HPE_ANW_Central
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

properties.description:
Reference Resource: [HPE_ANW_Central](#/HPE_ANW_Central)
HPE ANW Central configuration and status.

activate_server.description: IP address or URL of HPE ANW Activate server.

central_instantiation.description: HPE ANW Central instantiation: 'none':       CX is not connected to HPE ANW Central. 'public':     connected to Public HPE ANW Central. 'on_premise': connected to HPE ANW Central On Premise.

central_source.description: How the device is receiving the configuration for connecting to HPE ANW Central: 'none':            HPE-ANW-Central feature is disabled. 'cli':             connected using local configuration. 'activate':        connected to HPE ANW Activate Server. 'dhcp':            connected using the DHCP settings

central_source_alternative.description: How the device is receiving the configuration for connecting to HPE ANW Central with an alternative location: 'none':            HPE-ANW-Central feature is disabled. 'cli':             connected using local configuration. 'activate':        connected to HPE ANW Activate Server. 'dhcp':            connected using the DHCP settings

disable.description: Disables connection to HPE ANW Central.

location.description: IP address or URL of HPE ANW Central server.

location_alternative.description: IP address or URL of HPE ANW Central alternative server for CoP High Availability.

location_override_location.description: HPE ANW Central location. Accepts FQDN or IP address. This column value can be empty.

location_override_location_alternative.description: HPE ANW Central alternative location for CoP High Availability. Accepts FQDN or IP address. This column value can be empty.

location_override_vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF to connect HPE ANW Central. This column value can be empty.

location_override_vrf_alternative.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF to connect to HPE ANW Central when using the alternative location. This column value can be empty.

shared_token.description: The HPE ANW Central shared token for CoP.

source_ip.description: Source IP address of switch used in connection established to HPE ANW Central.

source_ip_alternative.description: Source IP address of the switch used to connect to the alternative HPE ANW Central cluster.

source_ip_overridden.description: Boolean flag indicating if the Source IP address was overridden.

source_ip_overridden_alternative.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the HPE ANW Central alternative cluster Source IP has been overridden.

status.description: Status of switch interaction with HPE ANW Central service.

central_connection.description: The connectivity status of the HPE ANW Central server: 'not_connected':            connection is not established. 'connected':                connection with HPE ANW Central is operational. 'connection_failure':       connection was attempteed, but failed. 'out_of_resources':         system is out of resources to make HPE ANW Central                             connection. See event logs for more details. 'reprovision':              HPE ANW Central requested the switch to be                              reprovisioned. Might be caused by change of                              customer region. Reprovisioning attempt would be                              performed automatically. 'request_handling_error':   An error occurred while handling a Central request. 'session_management_error': An error occurred while managing the Central session. 'no_license':               HPE ANW Central does not have a valid license for the device.

centralsource_connection.description: The connectivity status of the HPE ANW Activate server: 'connecting':         connecting to HPE ANW Activate. 'connected':          connection with HPE ANW Activate is operational. 'connection_failure': connection was attempted, but failed.

centralsource_last_connection_time.description: Indicates the timestamp (in seconds from epoch) for the last  time connection with HPE ANW Activate was operational.

location_connected.description: Specifies the Central location (either the main location or the alternative location) that successfully established a connection to HPE ANW Central. 'none':        No location connected. 'main':        Main location connected. 'alternative': Alternative location connected.

time_sync_with_activate.description: Indicates whether the system time was synchronized with  HPE ANW Activate service. Happens if NTP is not configured on the  system.

vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF used for connecting to HPE ANW Central and HPE ANW Activate services.

vrf_alternative.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF used for connecting to HPE ANW Central and HPE ANW Activate services when using an alternative location.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
